events.name: Execute node actions and move to next one

events.comment:
The navigation system for the bot uses nodes to plan its path. 

When a node requires a jump, this system sets a lower distance threshold to ensure precise jumping. 

If no jump is needed, the threshold is increased based on the bot's speed (faster speed, greater threshold) for better steering and drifting. This adaptive threshold triggers actions at the right time for efficient and accurate movement.
If you want to see see the trigger distance, simply insert ONE Lineraycast object into the scene. and have one AI

events.name: Trigger Node Actions And move on to next node

events.comment:
The node actions control the bot.

Below is what a node can do to the bot:
- Force the bot to jump
- Reset the bot node counter (Current_NodeID) and count a lap for the bot.
- Increase the bot node counter, to move on to the next node (if FINISH is false)

Actions are executed based on the enabled object variables of the node.
The node should comply with these conditions to be chosen:
- It is the node the bot is trying to reach. (checked by making sure the node is on the same position as the node position the bot is trying to reach 
 NodePosX and NodePosY)
- It is very near to the bot (By getting nearer than the threshold/distance set by the group above called Dynamic Threshold Calculation)
Trigger a respawn by hiding player or bot

I honestly regret using this system. I actually regret everything.
No idea if this game is worth it.
It wont make me popular for sure, and I dont want to be popular.

It will stay a hobby. A one I will enjoy without any worries (maybe).
